title: 第一卷 第11章 惊天一剑第一卷 第12章 洛寒衣的奖励
slug: 逆主马奴我以阴阳证大道
lines: 王龙决赛的对手叫沈岳。
侯府护卫队统领，三十出头，面容冷峻，身材修长，站在那里像一杆标枪，周身气势凌厉逼人。
二品中期武者。
在侯府所有家奴中，他毫无疑问是战力天花板！
沈岳缓步走到场中，目光落在王龙身上，眼中没有轻蔑，只有一种猎手审视猎物般的冷静。
沈岳说着缓缓摆开架势。
他双手虚按，掌心向下，十指微曲，像是一只蓄势待发的猛虎。
灵气在他周身流转，衣袂无风自动，脚下的青砖地面出现细密的裂纹，向四周蔓延。
院中众人纷纷后退，让出更大的空间。
“二品武者，果然不一样！”
“这气势，跟张头儿完全不是一个层次的。”
“那老东西再厉害，也不可能是沈统领的对手吧？”
“二品对一品，差距摆在那里，没什么悬念。”
窃窃私语声中，王龙微笑着回礼。
“沈统领，请！”
但他那双浑浊的老眼里，映着沈岳周身流转的灵气，瞳孔深处有一缕精光在闪烁。
洛寒衣端坐在主位上，她盯着场中，眉头微蹙。
二品对一品。
境界差距摆在那里，这是实打实的鸿沟。
王龙虽然跟她双修了好几天，但才踏入武者三天，根基尚浅。
毫无胜算！
秦明岚倚在柱子上，看看王龙，又看向沈岳。
“这老东西不会被打死吧？”
秦明岚嘟囔了一句，语气里带着一丝连她自己都没察觉的担忧。
毕竟能照顾踏雪的只有王龙，若是他死了以后谁来照顾踏雪啊！
“接招！”
沈岳率先出手。
只见他双脚蹬地，整个人如离弦之箭般射出，速度快得惊人，在原地留下一道残影。
拳头裹挟着凌厉的灵气，直取王龙胸口。
这一拳，没有花哨的招式，只有一个字——
快！
快到极致！
王龙瞳孔骤缩，身体本能地向左侧闪避。
拳头擦着他的衣襟掠过，劲风刮得他脸上的皮肤生疼。
拳风落空，轰在身后的地面上，青砖炸裂，碎石飞溅，留下一个尺许深的坑洞。
王龙还没站稳，沈岳的第二拳已经到了。
这一次是横扫，目标是他脖颈。
王龙仓促间抬起手臂格挡。
content_en:
Wang Long’s opponent in the final is Shen Yue.
The leader of the Hou Mansion's escort team is in his early thirties, with a stern face and a slender figure. He stands like a javelin and has a powerful aura around him.
A mid-level second-grade warrior.
Among all the domestic slaves in the Hou Mansion, he is undoubtedly the ceiling of combat power!
Shen Yue walked slowly into the field and his eyes fell on Wang Long. There was no contempt in his eyes, only the calmness of a hunter examining his prey.
"Please!"
Shen Yue said, slowly getting into his posture.
He pressed his hands, palms down, and his fingers slightly bent, like a tiger ready to attack.
Spiritual energy circulated around him, his clothes moved automatically without wind, and fine cracks appeared on the blue brick floor under his feet, spreading to all sides.
Everyone in the courtyard retreated to make way for more space.
"Second-grade warriors are indeed different!"
"This aura is completely different from Zhang Tou'er's."
"No matter how powerful that old guy is, he can't be Commander Shen's opponent, right?"
"Second-grade versus first-grade, the gap is there, there is no suspense."
Amidst the whispers, Wang Lung returned the favor with a smile.
"Commander Shen, please!"
But his turbid old eyes reflected the spiritual energy flowing around Shen Yue, and there was a ray of light flickering deep in his pupils.
Luo Hanyi was sitting in the main seat. She stared at the field and frowned slightly.
Second grade versus first grade.
The gap in realm is there, it is a real gap.
Although Wang Long had practiced dual cultivation with her for several days, he had only been a warrior for three days, and his foundation was still shallow.
No chance of winning!
Qin Minglan leaned on the pillar, looked at Wang Long, and then at Shen Yue.
"This old guy won't be beaten to death, right?"
Qin Minglan muttered, with a hint of worry in her tone that she didn't even notice.
After all, only Wang Long can take care of Ta Xue. If he dies, who will take care of Ta Xue?
"Take the move!"
Shen Yue took the lead.
I saw him kicking the ground with both feet, and his whole body shot out like an arrow from a string. The speed was astonishingly fast, leaving an afterimage on the spot.
The fist was wrapped with fierce spiritual energy and went straight to Wang Long's chest.
This punch has no fancy moves, just one word——
Quick!
Extremely fast!
Wang Long's pupils shrank suddenly and his body instinctively dodged to the left.
The fists grazed his clothes, and the strong wind made the skin on his face hurt.
"Boom——!"
The punch failed and hit the ground behind him. The green bricks exploded and gravel flew, leaving a crater about a foot deep.
Before Wang Long could stand still, Shen Yue's second punch had already arrived.
This time it was a sweeping sweep, targeting his neck.
Wang Lung hurriedly raised his arm to block.
